summary_en: 120,000 shares (3.0% of 3,965,000 ex-treasury) up to ¥200M. Open-market acquisition 7 Jul–30 Nov 2026. Stated rationale: execute medium-term plan, improve capital efficiency, strengthen shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of treasury stock pursuant to Company Code Article 165, Paragraph 2)
translation_en_brief: On 6 July 2026, the board of Japaniace Co., Ltd. authorized a treasury stock acquisition program under Company Code Article 156 (read as Article 165(3)). The company will acquire up to 120,000 shares (3.0% of the 3,965,000 shares outstanding ex-treasury as of 31 May 2026) for a maximum outlay of ¥200 million via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (Growth segment). The acquisition window runs from 7 July to 30 November 2026. The stated purpose is to execute the medium-term business plan flexibly, improve capital efficiency, and enhance shareholder returns.
